scope: All enumerated delegated *.tar.gz at scan start, reading files in tar order with bounded recursion and no extraction. Exact byte pattern scan of member bytes and gzip-uncompressed representations; tar metadata and filenames are not source-read credit.

bounded_unscanned.reason: tar parser stopped before nonzero header; remaining entries unread

qualification: Literal matches are references, not proof that an archived script is active or that a hash names the current top-level file. Listed omissions, archive errors, non-.tar.gz formats and future/concurrently modified paths remain open.
